Message.Name: Clear Quote Message
Message.Description: The Clear Quote message instructs feed recipients to clear all quotes and Summary and/or ADAP information for the specified symbol on the specified market(s).

Field.Name: Last Update Timestamp
Field.Description: Timestamp of the last matching engine message that updated the quote information for this symbol in the Cboe One server's cache. Encoded as the number of nanoseconds since midnight.

Field.Name: Market Center
Field.Description: All Cboe Markets for this feed

Message.Name: Expanded Clear Quote Message
Message.Description: The Expanded Clear Quote message instructs feed recipients to clear all quotes and Summary and/or ADAP information for the specified symbol on the specified market(s). Used when the symbol exceeds eight characters.

Field.Name: Last Update Timestamp
Field.Description: Timestamp of the last matching engine message that updated the quote information for this symbol in the Cboe One server's cache. Encoded as the number of nanoseconds since midnight.

Message.Name: Fractional Symbol Summary Message
Message.Description: The Fractional Symbol Summary message delivers the Cboe consolidated best bid/offer and total executed volume across all applicable Cboe One US and Cboe One Canada books.

Field.Name: Last Update Timestamp
Field.Description: Timestamp of the last matching engine message that updated the quote information for this symbol in the Cboe One server's cache. Encoded as the number of nanoseconds since midnight.

Field.Name: Cboe Cumulative Executed Volume
Field.Description: Cumulative number of shares traded today across all applicable Cboe books.

Field.Name: Consolidated Best Bid Quantity
Field.Description: Titanium Equities number of buy-side shares available for this symbol.

Field.Name: Consolidated Best Ask Quantity
Field.Description: Titanium Equities number of sell-side shares available for this symbol.

Field.Name: National Cumulative Volume
Field.Description: In the US, cumulative number of shares traded today as reported to the CTA and UTP SIPs.

Message.Name: Expanded Fractional Symbol Summary Message
Message.Description: The Expanded Fractional Symbol Summary message delivers the Cboe consolidated best bid/offer and total executed volume across all applicable Cboe One Canada books. Used when the symbol exceeds eight characters.

Field.Name: Last Update Timestamp
Field.Description: Timestamp of the last matching engine message that updated the quote information for this symbol in the Cboe One server's cache. Encoded as the number of nanoseconds since midnight.

Field.Name: Cboe Cumulative Executed Volume
Field.Description: Cumulative number of shares traded today across all applicable Cboe books.

Field.Name: Consolidated Best Bid Quantity
Field.Description: Titanium Equities number of buy-side shares available for this symbol.

Field.Name: Consolidated Best Ask Quantity
Field.Description: Titanium Equities number of sell-side shares available for this symbol.

Field.Name: National Cumulative Volume
Field.Description: The sum of two values: the current Cboe Cumulative Executed Volume and the 15-minute delayed executed volume of other Canadian exchanges as reported by TMX IP.

Message.Name: Best Quote Update Message
Message.Description: The Best Quote Update message is used to update one side of the Cboe consolidated quote information for a symbol.

Field.Name: Last Update Timestamp
Field.Description: Timestamp of the last matching engine message that updated the quote information for this symbol in the Cboe One server's cache. Encoded as the number of nanoseconds since midnight.

Field.Name: Consolidated Quote Quantity
Field.Description: Titanium Equities number of shares available for this symbol.

Message.Name: Expanded Best Quote Update Message
Message.Description: The Expanded Best Quote Update message is used to update one side of the Cboe consolidated quote information for a symbol. Used when the symbol exceeds eight characters.

Field.Name: Last Update Timestamp
Field.Description: Timestamp of the last matching engine message that updated the quote information for this symbol in the Cboe One server's cache. Encoded as the number of nanoseconds since midnight.

Field.Name: Consolidated Quote Quantity
Field.Description: Titanium Equities number of shares available for this symbol.

Message.Name: Cboe Market Status Message
Message.Description: The Cboe Market Status message is disseminated to reflect a change in the status of a market.

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Timestamp of when the Market Status changed for the specified Market Center. Encoded as the number of nanoseconds since midnight.

Message.Name: ADAP Message
Message.Description: Each ADAP message delivers one or more updates for a Symbol's ADAP book. Each ADAP message contains one or more ADAP Block messages.

Field.Name: Last Update Timestamp
Field.Description: Timestamp of the last matching engine message that updated the quote information for this symbol in the Cboe One server's cache. Encoded as the number of nanoseconds since midnight.

Field.Name: ADAP Blocks
Field.Description: Number of ADAP Block messages to follow

Field.Name: ADAP Block Size
Field.Description: Size of each ADAP Block message

Field.Name: ADAP Block
Field.Description: Size of each ADAP Block message

Message.Name: Expanded ADAP Message
Message.Description: The Expanded ADAP message is identical to the ADAP message described previously, except for the length of the Symbol field which is expanded from 8 to 14.

Field.Name: Last Update Timestamp
Field.Description: Timestamp of the last matching engine message that updated the quote information for this symbol in the Cboe One server's cache. Encoded as the number of nanoseconds since midnight.

Field.Name: ADAP Blocks
Field.Description: Number of ADAP Block messages to follow

Field.Name: ADAP Block Size
Field.Description: Size of each ADAP Block message

Field.Name: ADAP Block
Field.Description: Size of each ADAP Block message

Message.Name: RPI Message
Message.Description: The Retail Price Improvement (RPI) message is a retail liquidity indicator that includes symbol and side, but not price and size. US Only.

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Timestamp of the matching engine RPI message emitted by the specified Market Center. Encoded as the number of nanoseconds since midnight.

Message.Name: Fractional Trade Message
Message.Description: Fractional Trade messages are sent when an order is executed in whole or in part on a Cboe exchange.

Field.Name: Transaction Time
Field.Description: The time the trade occurred on the specified Market Center. Encoded as the number of nanoseconds since midnight.

Field.Name: Market Center
Field.Description: Market Center on which the last trade was executed

Field.Name: Market Center Execution ID
Field.Description: Market center specific execution identifier of this Execution. Execution ID is also referenced in the Trade Break message.

Field.Name: Cboe Cumulative Executed Volume
Field.Description: Cumulative number of shares traded today across all applicable books.

Field.Name: National Cumulative Volume
Field.Description: In the US, cumulative number of shares traded today as reported to the CTA and UTP SIPs.

Message.Name: Expanded Fractional Trade Message
Message.Description: The Expanded Fractional Trade message is identical to the Fractional Trade message described previously, except for the length of the Symbol field which is expanded from 8 to 14.

Field.Name: Transaction Time
Field.Description: The time the trade occurred on the specified Market Center. Encoded as the number of nanoseconds since midnight.

Field.Name: Market Center
Field.Description: Market Center on which the last trade was executed

Field.Name: Market Center Execution ID
Field.Description: Market center specific execution identifier of this Execution. Execution ID is also referenced in the Trade Break message.

Field.Name: Cboe Cumulative Executed Volume
Field.Description: Cumulative number of shares traded today across all applicable books.

Field.Name: National Cumulative Volume
Field.Description: The sum of two values: the current Cboe Cumulative Executed Volume and the 15-minute delayed executed volume of other Canadian exchanges as reported by TMX IP.

Message.Name: Fractional Trade Break Message
Message.Description: The Fractional Trade Break message is sent whenever an execution on a Cboe exchange is broken.

Field.Name: Transaction Time
Field.Description: The time the trade break occurred on the specified Market Center. Encoded as the number of nanoseconds since midnight.

Field.Name: Market Center
Field.Description: Market Center on which the last trade was executed

Field.Name: Market Center Execution ID
Field.Description: Market center specific execution identifier of trade to be broken.

Field.Name: Cboe Cumulative Executed Volume
Field.Description: Cumulative number of shares traded today across all applicable Cboe books.

Field.Name: National Cumulative Volume
Field.Description: In the US, cumulative number of shares traded today as reported to the CTA and UTP SIPs.

Message.Name: Expanded Fractional Trade Break Message
Message.Description: The Expanded Fractional Trade Break message is sent whenever an execution on a Cboe exchange is broken. Used when the symbol exceeds eight characters.

Field.Name: Transaction Time
Field.Description: The time the trade break occurred on the specified Market Center. Encoded as the number of nanoseconds since midnight.

Field.Name: Market Center
Field.Description: Market Center on which the last trade was executed

Field.Name: Market Center Execution ID
Field.Description: Market center specific execution identifier of trade to be broken.

Field.Name: Cboe Cumulative Executed Volume
Field.Description: Cumulative number of shares traded today across all applicable books.

Field.Name: National Cumulative Volume
Field.Description: The sum of two values: the current Cboe Cumulative Executed Volume and the 15-minute delayed executed volume of other Canadian exchanges as reported by TMX IP.

Message.Name: Trading Status Message
Message.Description: The Trading Status message is used to indicate the current trading status of a security on a Cboe exchange.

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Timestamp of the matching engine trading status message emitted by the specified Market Center. Encoded as the number of nanoseconds since midnight.

Message.Name: Expanded Trading Status Message
Message.Description: The Expanded Trading Status message is identical to the Trading Status message described previously, except for the length of the Symbol field which is expanded from 8 to 14. Canada Only.

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Timestamp of the matching engine trading status message emitted by the specified Market Center. Encoded as the number of nanoseconds since midnight.

Message.Name: Opening Closing Price Message
Message.Description: The Opening/Closing Price message is used to indicate the Opening or Closing price of a security on any of the Cboe markets and the primary listing market.

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: The time the eligible trade occurred on the specified Market Center. Encoded as the number of nanoseconds since midnight.

Message.Name: Expanded Opening Closing Price Message
Message.Description: The Expanded Opening/Closing Price message is identical to the Opening/Closing Price message described previously, except for the length of the Symbol field which is expanded from 8 to 14. Canada Only.

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: The time the eligible trade occurred on the specified Market Center. Encoded as the number of nanoseconds since midnight.

Message.Name: Fractional End of Day Summary Message
Message.Description: The Fractional End of Day Summary message is used to give a consolidated, high-level overview of a security for the day.

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: The timestamp of the originating SIP summary message. Encoded as the number of nanoseconds since midnight.

Field.Name: Opening Price
Field.Description: Opening Price. 0 if the system has not received an opening price for the security.

Field.Name: High Price
Field.Description: Highest trade price of the day.

Field.Name: Low Price
Field.Description: Lowest trade price of the day.

Field.Name: National Cumulative Volume
Field.Description: For US, cumulative volume of shares traded as reported to the national consolidators (SIPs).

Message.Name: Expanded Fractional End of Day Summary Message
Message.Description: The Expanded Fractional End of Day Summary message is identical to the Fractional End of Day Summary message described previously, except for the length of the Symbol field which is expanded from 8 to 14. Canada Only.

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: The timestamp of the originating SIP summary message. Encoded as the number of nanoseconds since midnight.

Field.Name: Opening Price
Field.Description: Opening Price. 0 if the system has not received an opening price for the security.

Field.Name: High Price
Field.Description: Highest trade price of the day.

Field.Name: Low Price
Field.Description: Lowest trade price of the day.

Field.Name: National Cumulative Volume
Field.Description: For Canada, the sum of two values: the current Cboe Cumulative Executed Volume and the 15-minute delayed executed volume of other Canadian exchanges as reported by TMX IP.

Struct.Name: Short Update ADAP Block
Struct.Description: Short Update ADAP Block for ADAP messages. Contains price level updates with 4-byte Binary 4.4 prices.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Price level to add/update for Market Center's ADAP book.

Field.Name: Quantity
Field.Description: Quantity of shares at this price level in the Market Center's ADAP book. A value of zero implies deletion of this ADAP level.

Struct.Name: Long Update ADAP Block
Struct.Description: Long Update ADAP Block for ADAP messages. Contains price level updates with 8-byte Binary 8.4 prices.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Price level to add/update for Market Center's ADAP book.

Field.Name: Quantity
Field.Description: Quantity of shares at this price level in the Market Center's ADAP book. A value of zero implies deletion of this ADAP level.

Value.Name: All Cboe Markets
Value.Description: All Cboe Markets for this feed
